newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Fishers Intl buys two loss adjuster firms.
newsitem.headline: Fishers Intl buys two loss adjuster firms.

text.p: Fishers International Plc said on Thursday that it proposes to acquire the Farrell Group and Applied Technology Adjusting International Limited, two firms of chartered loss adjusters.
The initial consideration will be 4.24 million Irish pounds which represents 60 percent of an initial valuation of 7.07 million attributed to the two companies by the board of Fishers.

Further consideration and the final valuation of the two firms will be subject to the levels of profitability achieved by them over the three years ending December 31, 1999, Fishers said in a statement.
